items.q: A 20-year-old male develops painful forearm muscle cramps and reddish-brown urine following heavy weightlifting. With resting, he experiences a 'second-wind' phenomenon. Deficiency of which enzyme causes McArdle disease (GSD Type V)?
items.exp: McArdle disease is muscle glycogen phosphorylase deficiency, preventing glycogen breakdown into glucose-1-phosphate during anaerobic exercise, causing painful cramps and myoglobinuria.
r: Correct. McArdle disease is muscle glycogen phosphorylase deficiency, preventing glycogen breakdown into glucose-1-phosphate during anaerobic exercise, causing painful cramps and myoglobinuria.
Incorrect. Liver glycogen phosphorylase (Hers disease) does not explain the primary biochemical mechanism described.
Incorrect. Phosphofructokinase-1 (Tarui disease) does not explain the primary biochemical mechanism described.
Incorrect. Acid alpha-glucosidase (Pompe disease) does not explain the primary biochemical mechanism described.
